page_title: Codex auto-resume after usage limits on Mac — Continua

sources.entry: Continua - Experimental macOS 13+ companion designed to resume interrupted Codex Desktop coding tasks after supported usage resets, with local task history; unsigned/not notarized, manual updates, and genuine unattended recovery unverified. #free

summary.name: Continua
summary.one_liner: Continua is an experimental macOS utility that preserves a Codex coding task interrupted by usage limits, waits for the usage reset, and resumes the same task in its original environment.
use_cases: Resume a Codex coding task automatically after usage limits reset
Leave a long AI coding task running overnight without manual restart
Keep an interrupted Codex Desktop task in its original environment
Track local history of interrupted and continued coding tasks
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a listening mode that watches for a supported Codex usage interruption and keeps the exact interrupted task. When the usage reset arrives, it checks that the task is safe to continue, then sends the continuation back to the original Codex task and host. It shows states such as waiting for reset, checking, continuing, and task continued, and says it is ready for the next interruption. The page is a web reconstruction of the native SwiftUI customer view, with Milkyway as the sample project.
notable: Waits for supported Codex usage reset and resumes the same task in its original host
Checks the task is safe to continue before resuming
Web page is a reconstruction of the native SwiftUI app UI
caveats: Experimental; unsigned and not notarized, with manual updates
Genuine unattended recovery is unverified per the listing
Works only with supported Codex usage interruptions and resets
